doc: A Warden 3D model's own shading over the shared painted look (WardenGlb.look), keyed by the model's art name (art/wardens/<art>/<art>.glb; a design variant has its own key). painted: hero_toon.gdshader parameters on all of its surfaces, set after WardenGlb.PAINTED. slots: the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, eyes, glow), after painted. Colours are [r, g, b]. A model without an entry keeps the shared look. Useful keys: rim_far and rim_far_color (a rim in the Hunter's signature colour at the match camera), top_light (surfaces facing up lift), fres and fres_tint (the coloured rim; 1 = lightened own colour), far_lift (brighter and richer at the match camera), shade and shadow_tint (the shadow floor and its tint), sheen, glow (emission x the painted colour), light_neutral_warm (takes the hue out of warm lights too: black cloth and gunmetal stay black and grey under an orange sun). halos: glow discs of a constant size on screen on the model's anchors (a lens a pixel wide at the match camera): anchor, color, strength, px (radius on screen), near and far (m: none this close, full from there; close-ups keep the lens itself). Match zoom (the shared far_* look, WardenGlb.PAINTED; set these per model only to tune it): far_fres (the pale fresnel's share left at the match camera, 0.35), far_spec (gloss, sheen and the lights' rims there, 0), far_clamp (stray texels pulled to their coarser mip, 0.8), far_rim_soft (1: rim_far is a broad saturated band in rim_far_color; keep rim_far 0.25-0.35), far_glow (whatever glows a step brighter there, 0.6). no_ink: material tags or slots drawn without the ink shell (e.g. ["gum", "crossbow"]). ink: the model's own ink shell, far_thin (0.8), far_cut (0.55: gone from ~13.5 m; 0 keeps it), color. glow_shell: the glow slot's halo at the match camera (glow_px 1.4 screen px, glow_k 1.3, glow_near 7, glow_far 14 m, glow_col; {"glow_px": 0} for none). A card slot's far keys (shaders/warden_card.gdshader, under slots.card): far_sheen 0, far_edge 1, far_alpha 1.35.
